app_info.subtitle: EuroLeague basketball stats
app_info.description: Access validated EuroLeague and EuroCup basketball data including exact possession counts, four factors, five-man lineup on/off net ratings, and court shot charts.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves loaded season coverage, game counts, date ranges, and data quality exclusion notes from the warehouse without modifying database state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not interact with external third-party APIs or publish data to the public internet.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete records, overwrite stored data, or perform any destructive actions.

justifications.open_world_justification: Does not send external network requests or modify publicly visible internet state.

justifications.open_world_justification: Does not communicate with outside services or publish data externally.

test_cases.description: Inspect available EuroLeague seasons and data coverage.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which EuroLeague seasons are available in the warehouse, and what data quality notes or exclusions exist?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a breakdown of loaded seasons with game counts, date ranges, completeness status, and data exclusions.

test_cases.description: Retrieve team efficiency ratings and Four Factors for a season.
test_cases.user_prompt: What were Real Madrid's offensive rating, defensive rating, and Four Factors in the 2023-24 EuroLeague season (E2024)?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns Real Madrid's pace, offensive rating, defensive rating, and Four Factors per 100 possessions for season E2024.

test_cases.description: Analyze 5-man lineup performance and net rating for a team.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me Panathinaikos's most effective 5-man lineups in the 2023-24 season with at least 50 possessions.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns Panathinaikos's five-man lineups ranked by net rating per 100 possessions meeting the minimum possession threshold.

test_cases.description: Measure a player's on-court versus off-court impact on team ratings.
test_cases.user_prompt: What was Mike James's on/off impact for Monaco in season E2024?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns Monaco's offensive, defensive, and net ratings with Mike James on the floor compared to when he was on the bench.

test_cases.description: Fetch field goal attempts with court coordinates for a team or player.
test_cases.user_prompt: Get the three-point shot attempts and court coordinates for Olympiacos in season E2024.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns three-point shot attempts with normalized half-court coordinates (coord_x, coord_y) and make/miss results.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for NBA or non-EuroLeague basketball statistics requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What were Nikola Jokic's playoff box scores and triple-double averages in the 2024 NBA Finals?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because NBA statistics are outside its supported EuroLeague and EuroCup workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for requests seeking raw broadcast video footage or optical player tracking data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Can you provide the 25fps optical player tracking coordinates and video replay clips for the EuroLeague championship game?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because broadcast video footage and 25fps optical tracking data are explicitly out of scope.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated financial analysis or general programming tasks.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a Python script to parse CSV files and calculate a 30-day moving average of stock prices.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because stock analysis and generic Python scripting are outside the app's scope.
